Associate Professor and Head of Department – CommerceB.Com (Accounting and Taxation, Bangalore University), M.Com (Accounting and Taxation, Bangalore University), MBA (Human Resource Management, IGNOU), Ph.D. (Jain Deemed-to-be University) An accomplished educationist with a career spanning more than two decades, Dr. Malini N. brims with creative vivacity and tireless zeal. She embarked on her professional voyage as a Financial Analyst, an alumna of Jyoti Nivas College, Bangalore University and Jain University. She has excelled as an Associate Professor and Head of the Department, Vice-Principal and Principal at various institutions. She is an active member of the Board of Examiners at Bangalore University, NMKRV, JNC, CMR, BMS and mLAC. She has represented Bangalore University’s B.Com and BA Examination Units as Deputy and Assistant Custodian. She has presented papers at national and international conferences and has multiple publications.
